format.description:
This overrides metadata.format. If a TextContentStream was created using writeBlock(), we serialize

to CSV format. When we read, we need to know which format the file was saved in.

title:
A content store that is optimized for loading of textual data.

Optionally, the header and data can be transformed to c3 canonical csv using the rules specified in TextContentMetadata.

Unlike Content which chunks strictly based on number of bytes, TextContent chunks based on lines.
name: TextContentStream
